text_block_list.text:
Preparing for afternoon training.
...However, circumstances today are a bit different.
And that's because—

"This morning, while I was checking
Orfevre's schedule for today—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I have errands this afternoon.
I should be back right before training.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, indeed. None of my retainers are present today.
Give it your consideration.
—This is an exceptionally unusual situation.

"Because those attendants who constantly wait upon Orfevre
and look after her every need...
are naturally right there with her during training as well."

Normally, preparing training equipment and other necessary items
is something the Umamusume handles to some extent herself.
However—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I brought replacement horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
It's the uphill course after this, right?
I'll go make some extra drinks in the meantime!
choice_data_list: Sorry for always relying on you. It's not too much of a burden, is it?
I'm always putting you out, is it too much of a burden?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
No, it is no burden at all! Our King has simply
granted our desire to serve!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
We cross-referenced our schedules and
properly set up a shift rotation.
So please, let us help you.
"—Thus, in Orfevre's case, at least two students calling themselves her retainers always accompanied her, proactively taking on her daily chores."
That was precisely why, even on days when Orfevre's errands made her return right before training, everything could be prepared and ready in advance.

"However, today is different. I must handle
all the preparations by myself...!
I did start early, but—"
Ultra-heavy tires, battle ropes, and medicine balls made for Umamusumeâall of them are far too much for a human body, but... I just have to do it!

First are the tires.
I need five today... but one by one,
I should... be able to do it!

I somehow managed to finish hauling the tires.
Next, I need to borrow the deceptively heavy equipment,
like the ankle weights.

"...There is hardly any time left until training starts.
It would be a grave matter to keep Orfevre waiting."
(Crash—thud-thud-thump!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Not content with merely standing in my way, you dare to make a nuisance of yourself—
choice_data_list: Sorry! I just stumbled a little—
Sorry! I just lost my footing for a sec—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ……You, were you getting ready all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Is today... circuit training?
...Ah, right, my subjects aren't here.

Besides the wearable weight accessories I have on me,
there's still other equipment I haven't prepared yet.
I mustn't cut into Orfevre's precious training time. Hurry—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Wait.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...You can be remarkably rash at times.
Refrain from tasks that are beyond your depth.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Whether you rely on others or adjust the menu,
there are ways to handle it. Take that much into account.
choice_data_list: Still, that feels a bit too cruel...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tedious.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I will not permit you to destroy that body of yours without my say-so.

Was this... done out of consideration for me?
To be fair, today's preparations were physically
beyond my own capacity.

Though I feel somewhat pathetic about my human frailty and not handling things smoothly...
I am grateful for her thoughtfulness.
choice_data_list: Enlist the help of academy staff
Change part of the training menu

text_block_list.text:
I should ask the Academy staff for help here.
Knowing one's limits and properly relying on others is also an important part of the job.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...That is fine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You are likely better suited for intellectual work.
Delegate the physical labor to others.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Don't waste your talents on pointless busywork.

Let's change part of the training here.
We'll cancel using the battle ropes we couldn't prepare and switch to using the gym instead.
choice_data_list: The second half will be in the gym, though... is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Heh. Very well.

Orfevre nodded in good humor.
Accepting sudden changes without a fuss—
she truly has a generous heart.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: However, you must deeply reflect on this incident.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: As the King's property, that is.
